answer: One effective defense is a stake-weighted rate limit with escalating bonds: each identity must lock a deposit before acting, and the deposit grows with every new identity spawned from the same funding source, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand escalating bonds. Privilege rises like a terrace, cheap at the ground level and steep at the top, and the delta between an attacker's cost and any vote-rigging gain turns sharply negative. The ledger marks suspicious clusters in umber, letting honest peers route around them before damage spreads.
